title: an else-less if cannot supply a value
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

failure.justification: grammar if_expr requires else, so a parser may reject the form; an implementation that parses it as a statement must reject the missing value statically or at runtime.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.11: if is an expression only when both branches are present; a missing value cannot cross a typed let boundary.
